diff --git a/src/click/core.py b/src/click/core.py
index 666ad68..2c3c86f 100644
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ import errno
 import inspect
 import os
 import sys
+import threading
 import typing as t
 from collections import abc
 from collections import Counter
@@ -228,6 +229,10 @@ class Context:
         value is not set, it defaults to the value from the parent
         context. ``Command.show_default`` overrides this default for the
         specific command.
+    :param cleanup_timeout: Maximum time in seconds for cleanup operations
+                            during close(). If specified, must be a positive
+                            float. None (default) indicates no timeout, allowing
+                            cleanup to run indefinitely.
 
     .. versionchanged:: 8.2
         The ``protected_args`` attribute is deprecated and will be removed in
@@ -280,6 +285,7 @@ class Context:
         token_normalize_func: t.Callable[[str], str] | None = None,
         color: bool | None = None,
         show_default: bool | None = None,
+        cleanup_timeout: float | None = None,
     ) -> None:
         #: the parent context or `None` if none exists.
         self.parent = parent
@@ -427,6 +433,13 @@ class Context:
         #: Show option default values when formatting help text.
         self.show_default: bool | None = show_default
 
+        if cleanup_timeout is not None and cleanup_timeout <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("cleanup_timeout must be a positive float value")
+
+        #: Maximum time in seconds for cleanup operations in close().
+        #: None indicates no timeout (default behavior).
+        self.cleanup_timeout: float | None = cleanup_timeout
+
         self._close_callbacks: list[t.Callable[[], t.Any]] = []
         self._depth = 0
         self._parameter_source: dict[str, ParameterSource] = {}
@@ -607,7 +620,35 @@ class Context:
         :meth:`call_on_close`, and exit all context managers entered
         with :meth:`with_resource`.
         """
-        self._exit_stack.close()
+        if self.cleanup_timeout is None:
+            self._exit_stack.close()
+        else:
+            # Run cleanup with timeout
+            exception_holder: list[BaseException] = []
+
+            def cleanup_with_exception_capture() -> None:
+                try:
+                    self._exit_stack.close()
+                except BaseException as e:
+                    exception_holder.append(e)
+
+            cleanup_thread = threading.Thread(target=cleanup_with_exception_capture)
+            cleanup_thread.daemon = True
+            cleanup_thread.start()
+            cleanup_thread.join(timeout=self.cleanup_timeout)
+
+            if cleanup_thread.is_alive():
+                import warnings
+                warnings.warn(
+                    f"Context cleanup exceeded timeout of {self.cleanup_timeout} seconds "
+                    "and was forcibly terminated",
+                    RuntimeWarning,
+                    stacklevel=2
+                )
+            elif exception_holder:
+                # Re-raise the exception that occurred during cleanup
+                raise exception_holder[0]
+
         # In case the context is reused, create a new exit stack.
         self._exit_stack = ExitStack()
